detail.longDescription: In my current project, I'm working on a password validation system. I am using tkinter as my GUI coding module. For a better button design, I use the tkmacosx module, but if I try to set a command to a button with tkmacosx , the command doesn't work. I tried using the button with an easier code, and it still doesn't work. Can anyone help me? The button with the easier code: import tkinter as tk from tkmacosx import Button import time root = tk.Tk() root.title("Test") def Test_Command(): print("hello") time.sleep(1) print("It worked!!") Btn = Button(root, text = "los", command = Test_Command).pack() root.mainloop()
